Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC pixel-art upper-eye gaze atlas
Primary request: Create nine clearly distinct natural gaze directions from the supplied exact 3x3 source grid. Preserve this same woman and her warm, visibly happy expression with the original happy brows. Return one complete row-major 3x3 upper-face atlas, identical framing and native 64:35 aspect in every cell.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole reference: the exact prepared 3x3 grid made by repeating this portrait own happy open-eye source. Do not use any other image.
Direction order: top-left=up-left, top-center=up, top-right=up-right; middle-left=left, middle-center=center, middle-right=right; bottom-left=down-left, bottom-center=down, bottom-right=down-right. Both eyes must aim together. Diagonal directions visibly include both components. All nine directions are distinct.
Native-eye priority: At the final native 64x35 size, make each iris-pupil assembly small, shaded and naturally irregular, with a slightly flattened or asymmetrical silhouette built from discrete stepped pixel contours. It must not read as a smooth perfect circle, vector disk, square block, rectangle, or flat purple bar. Use a few adjacent muted violet-gray shades to give the iris a compact organic edge. Set the small dark pupil inside that iris; do not enlarge it. Let the upper and lower lids naturally overlap portions of the iris, as they do in the source. Do not leave a fully round purple disk floating unobstructed in the eye.
Lids and gaze anatomy: Draw continuous, coherent upper and lower eyelid contours in both eyes, connected naturally at the inner and outer corners. Preserve eye spacing and corners. For up gaze, raise the upper lids modestly to create genuine room for the irises; allow the lid edge to softly overlap the top of each iris. Keep this a gentle happy glance, never startled or enlarged. For down gaze, lower the upper lids and let them cover more of each iris. Horizontal and diagonal gaze remain inside each eye opening. No pupil may cross a lid onto skin. Do not move brows or whole sockets to fake gaze.
Color and expression: Keep tiny mild warm glints only, subdued and balanced between both eyes. Retain the original brown skin/hair, pixel lattice, crop and happy brow shape. Keep the middle-center looking straight ahead. Avoid new shine, stark white glints, broad sclera, giant irises, harsh contrast, changed expression, shifted brows, altered hair/background, gutters, border, labels, text, watermark or extra content.
